name: harness
description: Chat-turn driver. Wires memory + system prompt + LLM + tool catalog + tool runner into a single per-turn loop. Exposes \\.\pipe\wylde-harness with three unary chat.* actions: start_turn, run_turn, cancel. The streaming verbs (stream_turn, stream_tools) are Rust-only (true ChunkFrame streaming via the wylde-harness binary).
